_comment: What `validate` holds THIS project to. Project policy, read by scripts/validate_tree.py;
a project without this file has its git-tracked runs* directories checked, no floors,
no scorer sources and only the bundled demo's duplicate exception.
committed       the run directories reports cite: V7 (every run has metrics.json),
V8 (no duplicate config_id) and V9 (every tracked file on disk)
floors          V9: each directory must keep at least this many runs, so deleting
evidence fails; raising one is a deliberate edit
scorer_sources  V10: runs that claim the current scorer, and the code that says what
the current scorer is. module is a .py path relative to this project's
root; callable returns a hash or a dict of named hashes
duplicate_ok    V8: (dataset_id, config_id) pairs allowed to repeat, each one justified
configs         V18: globs, relative to this project's root, of arm configs kept outside
data/configs (the examples' arms), so their model_record notes are seen
